typical: If something is typical, it is normal, and not special. It's what you would expect.
This rain isn't typical. We almost never get rain at this time of year.
typo: A typo is a mistake made when or . When a person types the wrong letters for a word when the person really knows what the right letters are, that is a typo.
It was just a typo; he wrote "dgo" but he meant "dog".
type: A type is one thing or a group of things that are all members of a larger group because of some similarity.
I use the same type of camera at work.
A type is a person who is like people from a particular group who are all similar in some way.
He's not the usually football type.
Type is letters that have been printed by a machine.
The type in this book is too small to read.
Type is the blocks of metal with raised letters used to print text.
With Gutenberg's movable type printing, books could be made using less money.
If you type something, you write it using a keyboard.
I typed up the letter very quickly, so I hope there are no mistakes.
If you type something, you put it into a particular group because of some group similarity.
The Red Cross collects the blood and the technicians in the hospitals cross and type it.
typhoon: A typhoon is a kind of storm in the Western Pacific Ocean.
typewriter: A typewriter is a machine used to type words by pressing keys that put ink onto paper.
tyre: A tyre is the outer part of a car wheel. It is usually made of rubber.
typist: A typist is a person who writes things using a typewriter.
He was a good typist, and could write more than 40 words per minute.
typically: If something typically happens, it happens in a common or expected manner.
tycoon: A tycoon is a wealthy and powerful business person.
Chairman Yu is a tycoon who owns multiple hotel chains.
typography: Typography is the appearance and style of something that is printed.
typeface: A typeface is the design of a font, or a font family.
typesetter: A typesetter is a person who sets or composes type.
A typesetter is a typesetting machine.
tyrant: A leader of a country who has total control over everything.
